Multiple signs indicate that Siri AI will land on HomePod through new hardware, and leaker pdfu shared the appearance of the new Siri on HomePod today.

HomePod 27's code has added support for Siri AI features, and is equipped with a brand-new status indicator light

Apple never comments on future products, but for the past several months there have been reports that Siri AI will debut on the upcoming new Apple TV 4K and HomePod devices.

When Apple launched Siri AI in June, it made no mention whatsoever of this voice assistant coming to tvOS or HomePod systems. Many people believe it is because the new Siri requires unreleased new hardware.

Leaker pdfu posted on social platform X, and we may be able to get our first glimpse of Siri AI running on HomePod. Below is the post and video:

The post pointed out that the HomePod 27 software already contains the code needed to run Siri AI, it just has not been enabled externally for now.

pdfu added in another post that it cannot be determined at present whether Siri AI will be limited to new hardware only, but it looks almost certain to be the case.

If Apple intended to bring Siri AI to older HomePod models, they would very likely have announced this feature back in June. The company's complete silence on Home products supporting Siri AI strongly suggests there will be strict hardware limitations.

What are your thoughts on the design of the new Siri AI on HomePod? Feel free to share your opinions in the comments section.
